description: Record the target tab to MP4 using Chrome's built-in encoder, without FFmpeg. Requires Chrome with Page.startScreenRecording support. The recording continues until browser_screencast_stop.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

filePath.description: MP4 path; defaults to the local artifacts directory; existing files are never replaced
